_comment: This is the file you edit by hand. build.mjs signs it into config.<channel>.json.
Three rules, and breaking any of them costs a customer something:
1. version only ever goes UP. A deployment refuses a catalogue that is not newer.
2. To undo a bad release, publish a HIGHER version carrying the old content.
Deleting the file does nothing: the CDN keeps serving what it cached.
3. Nothing customer-specific goes in here. This repo is public.
notes: Re-read priceSource and the deprecations page on 2026-10-15. gemini-3.7-flash is now an alias that the provider routes to gemini-3.8-flash, and gemini-3.5-flash one that routes to gemini-3.6-flash; both are marked deprecated and every chain that named them now names the model actually serving the call, so nothing a deployment calls changes. gemini-3.5-flash repriced to what 3.6-flash bills (0.75 / 0.075 / 3.75, was 1.5 / 0.15 / 9). retiresOn set on gemini-3.1-flash-lite (2027-05-07) and gemini-embedding-001 (2028-05-14); no chain moves off them yet.

models._vision_comment: vision is what build.mjs checks an image-reading chain against, so it is a claim about the model rather than a label. Confirmed from the model pages on 2026-09-23: 3.8, 3.7, 3.6, 3.5, 3.5-lite and 3.1-lite all list Image as an input. 3.7 and 3.5 are now aliases for 3.8 and 3.6.

gemini-3.8-flash._comment: โมเดล Flash รุ่นล่าสุด ประสิทธิภาพสูงสำหรับการประมวลผลทั่วไป งาน Agentic และงานที่ใช้เหตุผลซับซ้อน. Inputs include Image; still in no chain.

gemini-3.7-flash._comment: เน้นงานเขียนโค้ด งาน Agentic Workflows และปรับระดับความคิด (Thinking Level) ได้. Since 2026-10 the endpoint is an alias: the deprecations page says it is not shutting down and routes every request to gemini-3.8-flash, and the pricing page no longer lists it. Price is 3.8 Flash's, which doubles on 1 January 2027 like it. Kept so a deployment still on an older catalogue can price it; no chain names it since v12.

gemini-3.6-flash._comment: โมเดลเสถียรสำหรับการใช้งานจริง เพิ่มประสิทธิภาพ Token และลด Latency ในราคาประหยัด. Same rate as 3.8 and 3.7 flash, and like them it doubles on 1 January 2027: input 1.5, cached 0.15, output 7.5. Nothing in this format expresses a dated change, so someone has to publish that on the day. Inputs include Image.

gemini-3.5-flash._comment: โมเดลความเร็วสูงมาตรฐาน รองรับการประมวลผล Multimodal และบริบทขนาดใหญ่ (Long Context). Since 2026-10 the endpoint is an alias that routes every request to gemini-3.6-flash, and the pricing page no longer lists it, so the price is 3.6 Flash's (was 1.5 / 0.15 / 9). Doubles on 1 January 2027 with 3.6. No chain names it since v12.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite._comment: โมเดล Lite เวอร์ชันล่าสุด ออกแบบมาเพื่อเน้นความเร็วสูงสุดและราคาประหยัด เหมาะกับงาน High-volume

gemini-3.1-flash-lite._comment: โมเดลขนาดเล็กราคาประหยัด เหมาะสำหรับงานสรุปความ จัดหมวดหมู่ และการดึงข้อมูลจากเอกสาร. Page quotes text/image/video at 0.25 and audio at 0.50; input here is the text number. It is now dearer than 3.5-flash-lite on input and output both, while sitting below it as the fallback in eight chains — so falling back currently costs more than not falling back. Shutdown announced for 2027-05-07, replacement gemini-3.5-flash-lite. retiresOn published first in v12; chains move off it in a later version.

gemini-embedding-001._comment: Embeddings bill input only. dim is part of the model's identity here: stored vectors were written at this size and cosine against a different size is meaningless, not merely worse. Shutdown announced for 2028-05-14, replacement gemini-embedding-2. Moving means re-embedding the whole table, since vectors from two models cannot share it. The pricing page no longer has a section for this model; 0.15 is the rate it quotes for File Search embeddings.

purposes._comment: Keys are the feature ids the code already passes to callGeminiWithResilience. Keep them identical to those strings, so the model map and the cost report name things the same way. default covers any feature added later.
purposes._auto_reply_comment: Lite first since v9: measured faster, cheaper and as correct as 3.7-flash on the product's own prompt (omnichannel-ai-gateway docs/report/ai-model-chain.md). 3.8-flash stays last as the way through when both lite models fail (3.7-flash until v12, which now routes to 3.8 anyway).
purposes._pet_comment: pet-triage reads an owner's description of symptoms. Lite leads since v11, like every chain (owner's decision 2026-10-01); gemini-3.8-flash follows as the fallback. Not measured on triage questions. pet-replenishment only phrases a supply estimate already worked out in code, so it stays on the lite pair.
purposes._vision_comment: Every chain below reads an image, so every model in them must have vision:true. build.mjs checks that.
purposes._vaccine_comment: vaccine-book-scan reads a handwritten vaccine book page. Lite leads since v11 (owner's decision 2026-10-01), with 3.8 and 3.6 Flash behind it (3.5 Flash until v12, which is now an alias for 3.6). Note before trusting it: in the pet-care project's own tries the lite pair misread mock pages more often than Flash — measure on real pages.
purposes._embedding_comment: Single entry on purpose. A fallback here would write vectors of a second model into one table, and retrieval reads that table without filtering by model.
